cases.question: smlouva o dílo Haus365 SIS
cases.notes: 11 documents - the whole revision family of one contract (návrh/rev2/k podpisu/připomínky), which is the intended answer for a query naming no revision. Broadest ground truth in this file; treat a rank change here as weak evidence.

cases.question: revize smlouvy o dílo NDS Property SIS Systémy
cases.notes: 1 document. THE monolithic-chunk case: before the CHUNK_MAX_SIZE fix this file was 2 chunks with a 114221-char maximum, BGE-M3 silently embedded a fraction of it, and the query missed the top 10 entirely. Post-reindex it is 456 chunks / 2095 max and ranks #1. A MISS here means chunk capping regressed.

cases.question: dodatek č.1 Hilti Rent podchycení sloupů
cases.notes: 2 documents (the signed dodatek and its confirmation). Needle is deliberately narrower than 'Hilti', which matches an unrelated delivery note, and than 'podchycení', which matches 10 documents of the whole procurement including the original SoD.

cases.question: dodatek SoD geotermální vrty SG Geosan
cases.notes: 5 documents - the dodatek in its .docx/.pdf/signed variants. A bare 'SG Geosan' needle matched 95 documents (the entire supplier folder) and is not usable.

cases.question: Haus365 technologický postup monolit
cases.notes: 1 document. GROUND TRUTH CORRECTED 2026-08-08: the earlier needle 'VT 11_HAUS365' pointed at a quantity SPREADSHEET (výkaz), not a technological procedure, so the case measured the wrong document; before that it used a bare 'haus365' needle matching 60 documents and passed unconditionally.

cases.question: Haus365 kladečský plán výrobní dokumentace
cases.notes: 0 documents: no file matching 'kladeč' is in the index and FTS finds no chunk containing the term either, so no retrieval change can make this pass. Kept as a tripwire - the day the source folder gains the drawing, this case flips to HIT and tells us. MISS is the expected result and is not counted as a retrieval failure.

cases.question: předání pracoviště Haus365
cases.notes: 5 documents - the handover-record form and its filled copies.

cases.question: změnový list roznášecí deska FERI
cases.notes: 2 documents (change list 001 and 002 for FERI-Garáže). No document has 'roznášecí' in its name, so the needle names the change-list family the query is about.

cases.question: přehled změnových listů GD
cases.notes: 6 documents (dated revisions of one overview spreadsheet). GROUND TRUTH CORRECTED 2026-08-08: the old needle 'Zmenovy_list' pointed at INDIVIDUAL change lists, not at the overview the query asks for, and made the case report a false regression across the reindex (#7 -> #9) at the very moment the actual overview spreadsheets entered the top 10 for the first time. With the correct needle the same two runs read MISS -> #3. These are .xlsx files that were unreadable before the extractor fix, so this case now doubles as XLSX extraction coverage.

cases.question: ZL 006 demolice podzemních objektů
cases.notes: 7 documents - the change list plus its revisions and attachments.

cases.question: technologický postup odvodnění Watersystem
cases.notes: 1 document. A bare 'WATERSYSTEM' needle matched 22 documents (the supplier folder) and was too weak to detect ranking changes.

cases.question: technologický postup stříkané betony ZG
cases.notes: 5 documents. The filename is unaccented ('Technologicky postup strikane betony ND') while the query is accented - matching folds diacritics, so this case also covers that folding.

cases.question: prohlášení zhotovitele k BOZP a PO
cases.notes: 6 documents - the declaration form as filed per supplier.

cases.question: BOZP SafetyPeak podepsaná
cases.notes: 1 document. The query asks for the SIGNED copy specifically, so the needle must exclude the unsigned NOT250060_BOZP_SafetyPeak.docx sitting next to it - a bare 'SafetyPeak' needle matched 54 documents and could not tell the two apart.

cases.question: kontrolní a zkušební plán monolit FERI
cases.notes: 4 documents, all indexed and chunked, but the query reaches only rank 29 in ai_search.search(limit=200) - a diagnosed vocabulary mismatch: the query spells out 'kontrolní a zkušební plán' (18384 resp. 86 FTS hits) while the documents only use the acronym 'KZP', and 'FERI' does not appear in any target name (they are the Smíchov KZPs). Reindexing could not and did not help. Reported every run but never fails it; the fix belongs in query expansion (KZP synonym), not here.

cases.question: seznam TP a KZP dodavatelů
cases.notes: 1 document (NDS_seznam TP a KZP.xlsx). THE xlsx-extraction case: the old extractor emitted shared-string INDICES instead of text and produced 4 chunks with a 6761-char maximum; the row-aware extractor produces 18 chunks averaging 767 chars and the rank moved #9 -> #1. A drop back toward #9 means spreadsheet extraction regressed.

cases.question: faktura Nazarenko stavební práce
cases.notes: 6 documents sharing the order number. The needle is the order number rather than the surname on purpose: 'Nazarenko' also matches attendance sheets and hour summaries (11 documents) that are not the invoice the query asks for.

cases.question: přefakturace nákladů GD na ZG
cases.notes: 3 documents - the re-invoicing statement and its revisions.

cases.question: předávací protokol Zakládání Group staveniště
cases.notes: 1 document. This is the case that exposed the post-rerank truncation bug in ui_services.search_all(): it sat at pool rank 11 and the pre-fix [:result_count] cut discarded it before dedup/diversify ran. A MISS here means that truncation ordering regressed. A bare 'Zakládání Group' needle matched 217 documents and is not usable.

cases.question: e-mail FERI závazné termíny SoD monolit
cases.notes: 1 document (.eml). Only e-mail case in the suite - covers that .eml extraction still reaches the index.
